seo.title: What is Sapphire FUE Hair Transplant? | High Graft & Natural Results
seo.description: Guide to achieving maximum graft transplantation in a single session with the FUE hair transplant method, natural hairline design, and permanent hair.

hero.title: FUE Hair Transplantation (Sapphire)
hero.subtitle: The world's most preferred gold standard method for covering large bald areas and reaching maximum graft count in a single session.

blocks.text: FUE (Follicular Unit Extraction) is the process of extracting hair follicles individually from the donor area using micro-motors and placing them into pre-opened micro-channels in the balding area. Today, these channels are opened using special blades with sapphire tips, a precious gemstone, to minimize tissue damage (Sapphire FUE).
✨ Key Feature: Thanks to the high graft extraction speed, the FUE method allows for transplanting up to 5,000 grafts in a single session for patients with extensive hair loss.

items: Allows for a very high number of root (graft) transplants in a single session.
When sapphire-tipped blades are used, the healing process is much faster and smoother.
Since hair follicles can be placed in alignment with their natural growth angle, the result is extremely natural.
Compared to the DHI method, the procedure duration is shorter and more cost-advantageous.

blocks.text: It is the number one choice, especially for individuals with advanced hair loss, a completely receded hairline, or large open areas at the crown. If the goal is to fill a completely empty area rather than thickening existing hair, the FUE method is the most ideal path.
How Does the FUE Recovery Process Work?

items: First 3 Days: The anchoring stage for transplanted roots; the area should not be touched.
Day 10: Scabs in the transplanted area completely shed through special washings.
Months 1 - 3: The 'Shock Loss' stage; transplanted hair falls out (this is completely normal).
Month 6: 60% of the hair visibly grows and begins to take shape.
Month 12: The final result is achieved; hair gains its natural and permanent form.

items.q: Will I feel pain during the operation?
items.a: No. Thanks to the local anesthesia applied before the procedure, the operation is completely painless and comfortable.

items.q: Will transplanted hair fall out again?
items.a: Since the transplanted hair follicles are harvested from the donor area at the back of the head, which is genetically coded not to fall out, they are permanent for a lifetime and will not fall out again.
